help_text:
📋 Available commands (groups only):

🔨 Moderation:
/ban — ban in this chat (moderators and up)
/gban — ban across all of the bot's chats with an announcement (admins and up)
/sban — silent ban in this chat (admins and up)
/sgban — silent ban across all of the bot's chats (admins and up)
/unban — unban in this chat as an exception (moderators and up)
/ungban — globally unban across all chats (admins and up)
/unsban — silent unban in this chat (admins and up)
/unsgban — silent global unban (admins and up)
/mute — mute (optional duration and reason; moderators and up)
/unmute — unmute (optional reason; moderators and up)
/gmute, /smute, /gsmute — global / silent / silent global mute (admins and up)
/ungmute, /unsmute, /ungsmute — matching unmute (admins and up)
/delete — delete the message you reply to (moderators and up)
/raid_on — enable anti-raid: ban all newcomers (admins and up)
/raid_off — disable anti-raid (admins and up)
Target: reply to a message, or @username/ID. /ban and /gban accept an optional reason.

👑 Role management (for admins and owners):
/add_adm — make a user an admin
/del_adm — remove an admin
/add_mod — make a user a moderator
/del_mod — remove a moderator

ℹ️ Other:
/rules — chat rules, available to everyone
/staff — chat staff (admins and moderators), available to everyone
/admin — admin panel in DM (manage roles and view logs; admins and owners, after captcha)
/help — this message (for moderators, admins and owners)
